data.name: Mouqib
data.gender_notes: Mouqib is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who keeps watch, observer, guardian. The name Mouqib carries the meaning “Observer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mouqib usually hope their child will grow to embody observer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Protector, guardian, observer, keeping watch over one's spiritual journey
data.etymology: Mouqib belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Observer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mouqib total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: موقب
in_arabic.meaning: موقب تعالی کا ایک نام، جو عزت دینے والا ہے
in_arabic.long_meaning: موقب (Mouqib) اللہ تعالی کا ایک صفاتی نام ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے 'عزت دینے والا' یا 'عزت دینے کا اہل'۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر نہیں آیا، لیکن یہ اللہ تعالی کے صفات کے आधार پر تشکیل دیا گیا ہے۔ موقب کا مطلب یہ بھی ہے کہ جو شخص اپنے عبادت گزاروں اور نیک کردار افراد کو عزت اور شان بخشتا ہے۔

in_urdu.name: موقب
in_urdu.meaning: موقب وہ جو عزت دیتا ہے، اللہ تعالی کا نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: موقب (Mouqib) اللہ تعالی کا ایک نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'وہ جو عزت دیتا ہے' یا 'عزت دینے والا'۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے 'وقب' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'عزت' یا 'شان'۔ موقب نام کا استعمال اسلامی تقویم میں اللہ تعالی کے اس صفت کو ظاہر کرنے کے لیے کیا جاتا ہے جو اپنے بندوں کو عزت اور توفیق بخشتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मौकिब
in_hindi.meaning: मौकिब वह जो सम्मान देता है, अल्लाह का नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: मौकिब (Mouqib) अल्लाह तआला का एक नाम है जिसका अर्थ है 'वह जो सम्मान देता है' या 'सम्मान देने वाला'। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के 'وقب' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है 'सम्मान' या 'शान'। मौकिब नाम का उपयोग इस्लामी परंपरा में अल्लाह तआला के उस गुण को प्रकट करने के लिए किया जाता है जो अपने सेवकों को सम्मान और सफलता प्रदान करता है।

in_pashto.name: موقب
in_pashto.meaning: موقب هغه څوک چې عزت ورکوي، د الله نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: موقب (Mouqib) د الله تعالی یو نوم دی چې معنی یې ده 'هغه څوک چې عزت ورکوي' یا 'عزت ورکوونکی'۔ دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه 'وقب' څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې ده 'عزت' یا 'شان'۔ موقب نوم د استعمال کېدونکي دی په اسلامي تاجک کې د الله تعالی دغه صفت ته ښودلو لپاره چې خپلو بندګانو ته عزت او بریاليت ورکوي.

in_english.name: Mouqib
in_english.meaning: One who gives honor, a name of Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Mouqib (Mouqib) is a name of Allah, meaning 'one who gives honor' or 'honor-giver'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'وقب' (waqaba), which means 'to honor' or 'to give prestige'. In Islamic tradition, Mouqib is used to describe Allah's attribute of bestowing honor and dignity upon His servants. The name Mouqib signifies the divine quality of elevating the status of believers and righteous individuals.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل (مو-قيب)

data.cultural_impact: The name Mouqib carries the essence of patience, vigilance, and responsibility. In Islamic tradition, it is known to be an important name for individuals serving in various roles where constant observation and alertness are crucial, such as security guards or night watchmen.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, Mouqib symbolizes the role of a dedicated servant of God, keeping a watch over his heart, actions, and thoughts to ensure obedience to divine commandments and striving for purity and closeness to Allah. The name reminds us of the importance of being mindful, aware, and constant in our relationship with the Divine and in ourservice to humanity.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Observer" symbolizes One who keeps watch, observer, guardian. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mouqib serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of observer.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Al-Tabari, Ibn Jamah, Al-Bukhari and Al-Muslim report that according to Ibn Abbas, the name of the star which was raised up for Prophet Ibrahim when he was thrown into the fire, was called Mouqib.
historical_references.time_period: Approx. 21st Century BCE, during the time of Prophet Ibrahim

historical_references.reference: Al-Qazwini in his book 'Ajayeb al-Makhlouqat' describes Mouqib as a star that rises in the constellation of Scorpio, which appears at the same time as Jupiter and is about the same size as the moon. He also mentions that it was considered an evil omen in ancient Persia and was believed to be a companion of the devil.

modern_usage.modern_context: The term 'Mouqib' in Islamic tradition refers to a night watchman who ensures the safety and security of a community during the night. In modern contexts, this term has been adopted in various ways across different platforms. On Instagram and Twitter, the hashtag #Mouqib is popular among astrology and spirituality communities, where individuals share their interpretations of dreams, personal reflections, and astrological insights. On TikTok, the term 'Mouqib' is used in a more lighthearted context, with users sharing funny videos or memes related to the term. Overall, the term 'Mouqib' continues to be a dynamic and evolving concept that reflects the intersection of spirituality, astrology, and technology in modern discourse.
